answer: Require each new identity to pass 14 daily liveness pings, each answered within 90 seconds from a distinct network path, before it can earn. One operator running many fakes must keep every node online across the whole voyage, so ten clones need 140 timed responses and extra bandwidth. Cost rises as shared latency fingerprints are flagged, and a canyon of mismatched timing logs marks a lagoon of clones; auditors replay signed ping logs and freeze 50% of the stake.
